$description: Facts the shared chrome carries on every page. build-pages.js stamps them into the masthead, the menu sheet and the colophon; edit here, then run `npm run pages`. The season is the issue's own, set here and never read from the visitor's clock.
name: Ben Siverly

resume.$description: The public résumé: the page and the one PDF it offers by default.

contact.$description: The address stays base64-encoded in the markup, as on the home page, and is decoded only when someone presses Copy.

home.$description: Two lines only the home colophon carries, where the old home page's intro and Elsewhere list now live. The ids keep the old #elsewhere-heading and #contact-heading links landing.
home.note: I care about shipping things that actually work, staying close to my family, and building a few things that might outlast me. Proud future ancestor of the Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma. Probably the most optimistic person you’ll meet.
home.outside: Native gardening in the Bay Area. Longevity science and preventive health. Liturgical practice and spiritual formation. Raising kids who are kind and grounded. Writing poetry and prose.

consulting.$description: Off until the consulting pages exist. On, the home and supplement colophons carry a line to consulting.html.
